newsitem.title: USA: Equity Office buys 6 properties for $290 mln.
newsitem.headline: Equity Office buys 6 properties for $290 mln.

text.p: Equity Office Properties Trust said Wednesday it will buy six office properties from Prudential Insurance Co of America for $290 million.
In a separate transaction, Equity said Prudential will buy $145 million of its restricted common shares at $24.50 per share.
The stock purchase may include an investment made on behalf of one or more institutional clients, as well as Prudential's own general account.
The six buildings total 2.5 million square feet in Houston, Dallas and Philadelphia. Average occupancy for the entire potfolio is 86.5 percent.
Equity said it will finance the acquisition through its unsecured line of credit and working capital.

The six properties are: Destec Tower, a 25-story building in Houston; Brookhollow Central I, II and III, a 795,455-square-foot office complex in suburban Houston; 8080 Central, a 17-story office building in Dallas; and 1700 Market, a 32-story office building in downtown Philadelphia.
